snippet.title: 「The Forest of Silver Shallots」 is now available in Steam Early Access! New PV has been released!
snippet.description:
「The Nonexistence of Morphean Paradox: The Forest of Silver Shallots」 has now officially launched into Early Access on the Steam platform! The Early Access price is $6.99 USD, with a 10% launch week discount! The 「NON」 Series Bundle is now available simultaneously, also enjoying a 10% discount! (Players who already own the previous game will get an even better deal on this bundle!)

This is the unfinished story between you and her—this is the journey that belongs to "YOU"...
Awakening within the Forest of Silver Shallots, you set forth on a path to uncover the secrets of the "Morphean Paradox."
Across the land, the schemes of great factions ripple across the surface, while beneath, dark mist stirs in hidden currents.
Forge bonds or sow hatred, and bear witness to the fate of "YOU," your companions, and the Silver Shallot Forest itself.
